name: app-sun-seeking-onboarding-gradient-screens
title: Onboarding screens on sunset-to-sky gradients with skin-tone swatches
whatItIs: Three phones in a row: a peach-to-lilac sign-up with a sunburst icon and Apple/Email buttons; a blue-to-yellow questionnaire with six skin-tone swatch cards and monospace descriptions; and a list of age options with the selected one in black.
whatItMeans: Warm, open and reassuring; the sun-inspired gradients make a personal questionnaire feel gentle.
techniques: Use a full-screen sunrise gradient as the background of a sign-in screen.
Show skin-tone options as coloured circles in tappable cards.
Highlight the selected option by inverting to black.
Add a step counter and back arrow to show progress.
bestFor: Apps needing an inclusive, friendly tone

vocabulary.definition: A gradient moving from warm orange through yellow to blue.
A tappable card with a colour sample.
Selected state shown as black fill with white text.
